purpose: View externally solved nodal displacement only; no browser solve, training admission or physical validation.

required.nodes_mm: N x 3 undeformed node coordinates in a single explicitly declared Cartesian frame
required.triangles: M x 3 zero-based surface node indices; export boundary faces, not internal tetrahedra
required.t_s: T finite, strictly increasing solver times
required.displacement_mm: T x N x 3 full vector displacements, not positions

provenance.solver: Name and version, including constitutive and element formulation
provenance.geometry_id: Geometry identity and source; do not mix historical and final hardware geometries
provenance.material: Material parameters, units and measured/assumed status
provenance.boundary_conditions: Supports, constraints, contact and load definition

display: Original displacement norm sets fixed sequence-wide colors. Gain scales geometry only. Each file has an independent solver timeline.
not_supported: Inferring displacement from the empirical 15-channel magnetic model
Arbitrary free dragging of precomputed FEM without a valid solver/surrogate
Treating declared validation as independent verification
Automatic admission to synthetic training data
